description: Known, unresolved defects that standard CI cannot detect (they need a live model). Every CI run summary lists them so a green build never hides them. Update only with evidence from a new live run.

defects.title: RAG over-abstention: the model answers 'not found' although the answer is in its context
defects.detected_by: live RAG evaluation (python -m ai_quality_lab.rag.evaluate --mode rag --llm ollama)
defects.ci_visibility: Not reproducible in standard CI: CI uses deterministic mock models, which do not over-abstain.

defects.title: LLM judge scores (Ragas, DeepEval) are unreliable on real answers; advisory only
defects.detected_by: judge calibration + manual review of live answers
defects.last_observed: 2026-10-30, Ragas calibration 9/9 but faithfulness misjudged 3 correct answers
defects.ci_visibility: Not evaluated in standard CI: judges need a model; judge scores never gate release.

defects.title: Deterministic fact checks cannot detect a muddled answer to contradictory documents
defects.detected_by: manual review of live RAG-011 answer
defects.ci_visibility: A limitation of the checks themselves; CI cannot show it.

defects.title: Pattern-based security controls can miss paraphrased prompt injection and plain-language disclosure
defects.detected_by: Phase 6 security review of the sanitizer and output guard (pattern lists)
defects.ci_visibility: CI only proves the known patterns are caught (RAG-016 to RAG-019 with a worst-case mock model); unknown paraphrases are by definition not in the dataset.
